SIT OF LOCATIONS/DEPARTMENTS/OPDS WARDS WHERE WATER BOTTLES/CANS ARE REQUIRED TO BE SUP PLIED ON DAILY BASIS FOR ACTUAL ESTIMATION OF REQUIRED ABOUR. 4. PAYMENT WILL BE MADE ON MONTHLY BASIS FOR NUMBER OF BOTTLES DELIVERED IN THE PRECEDING MONTH ON PRO RATA BASIS. 5. (III) PLASTIC BOTTLES/CANS USED FOR SUPPLY OF WATER ARE PURCHASED UNDER LAST SIX MONTHS AND PLASTIC OF THE SAME IS NOT DEGRADED. 6. THE BIDDER MUST HAVE AN AVAILABILITY OF SERVICE CENTER IN VISAKHAPATNAM AND REQUIRED TO SUBMIT DOCUMENTARY ADDRESS PROOF OF THE SAME. 7. APPROXIMATELY 150 WATER/BOTTLES ARE TO BE SUPPLIED 7 DAYS A WEEK FOR 12 MONTHS. HOWEVE R, PAYMENT WILL BE MADE ON MONTHLY BASIS FOR NO. OF BOTTLES DELIVERED IN PRECEDING MONTH P RO RATA BASIS. . 3.
